introduction:
Marriage registration in Rajasthan is governed by the Compulsory Registration of Marriages Act. The Government of Rajasthan facilitates marriage registration through the official Pehchan Portal (pehchan.rajasthan.gov.in), ensuring a hybrid process of online application followed by in-person verification.

A Marriage Certificate is a crucial legal document that acts as proof of marriage, essential for passport applications, bank accounts, visas, and other family-related legal benefits.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts & Key Details
  • Service: Marriage Certificate (विवाह प्रमाण पत्र)
  • State: Rajasthan
  • Portal Used: Pehchan Portal (pehchan.rajasthan.gov.in)
  • Mode of Application: Hybrid (Online form filling followed by a physical visit to the local registrar)
  • Processing Time: Usually 2 to 3 days after physical document verification at the office.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Original documents must be scanned and uploaded in the specified sizes during online registration.
Groom & Bride Proofs
  • Jan Aadhar Card: Optional, but highly recommended as it auto-fetches family details.
  • Aadhar Cards: Aadhar cards of the Groom (वर), the Bride (वधु), and the Applicant (आवेदक).
  • Active Mobile Number: Linked to your Aadhar card for receiving OTPs.
Photos & ID Scan Specifications
  • ID Proof of Applicant: Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card, or Ration Card (Scanned in JPG format, size 50 KB to 200 KB).
  • Joint Photograph: Combined, clear passport-size photo of the Groom and Bride (Scanned in JPG format, size 50 KB to 200 KB).
  • Witness Details: Name, address, and mobile number of at least two witnesses (one from the groom's side, one from the bride's side).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Hybrid Online Application (Pehchan Portal & Registrar Visit)

This hybrid process allows you to fill out the form online to save time before performing a quick offline verification:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Access the Portal: Open your browser and go to the official Rajasthan Civil Registration System portal (pehchan.rajasthan.gov.in).
  2. Navigate to Forms: Scroll down the homepage and click on the "आम जन - आवेदन प्रपत्र भरें" (General Public - Fill Application Form) block.
  3. Select Marriage Form: On the instructions page, select the radio button for "विवाह" (Marriage).
  4. Start New Application: In the new window (Form 15), select "नए आवेदन हेतु" (For New Application). Enter the Captcha code and click "प्रवेश करें" (Enter).
  5. Fill Marriage Details: Enter the date and location of the marriage (type the address in both Hindi and English). Select your State, District, Panchayat/Urban Local Body, and your specific local Registrar's Office from the dropdowns.
  6. Fill Groom & Bride Details: Enter their respective Jan Aadhar numbers to auto-sync details, or manually enter their Aadhar numbers, Names, Parents' Names, Date of Birth, Address, Nationality, Religion, Caste, and Educational Qualification (names and addresses must be typed in both Hindi and English).
  7. Fill Witness (गवाह) Details: Provide the names, addresses (in Hindi and English), and mobile numbers of the witnesses from both the groom's and bride's sides.
  8. Applicant Details & OTP Verification: Enter the details of the person applying. Select an ID proof type, enter its number, and fill in the applicant's name, Aadhar number, and address. Click "OTP प्राप्त करें" (Get OTP), enter the received code, and click Verify.
  9. Upload Files: Upload the Applicant's ID Proof and the Joint Photograph of the Groom and Bride using the upload buttons.
  10. Aadhar Authentication: Tick the consent box, enter the Captcha code, and click "प्रमाणीकरण" (Authenticate) to verify the Aadhar details electronically.
  11. Submit Form: Click the "इन्द्राज करें" (Submit/Register) button at the bottom. Save the generated Reference Number and Token Number immediately.
  12. Print Form: Click the prompt to print "Form 15". Save it as a PDF and print it out.
  13. Offline Visit & Verification: Take the printed application form, attach physical photocopies of all ID proofs, age proofs, and photographs, and visit the selected local Registrar's Office (Gram Panchayat, Nagar Palika, or Municipal Corporation). Both spouses and witnesses must present themselves before the registrar to sign and verify the physical documents.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Purely Offline Application Process

If you wish to apply completely offline, follow this procedure sourced from the latest government guidelines:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Local Office: Go to your local Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam), Sub-Registrar office, or Gram Panchayat office.
  2. Collect Form: Request the physical Marriage Registration Form (Form 15).
  3. Fill Details: Fill out the application form manually with the exact details of the marriage, groom, bride, and witnesses.
  4. Prepare Joint Affidavit: Draft and notarize a Joint Marriage Affidavit signed by both spouses stating the date, place of marriage, and mutual consent.
  5. Attach Proofs: Attach photocopies of all required proofs (Age proof, Address proof, Aadhar ID cards, wedding invitation card if available, and joint photographs).
  6. Submit Form: Submit the complete file to the counter and pay the nominal offline registration fee.
  7. Verification: The registrar will schedule a verification session where the couple and witnesses must sign the registry in front of the registrar.
afterApplying:
After Verification & Downloading Certificate

Approval Wait Time

Once physical verification is completed at the registrar's office, it usually takes 2 to 3 days for the registrar to digitally sign and approve your certificate.

How to Download

Go to the Pehchan portal homepage, click on "डाउनलोड सर्टिफिकेट" (Download Certificate), select the "विवाह" (Marriage) option, enter either your Registration/Reference Number or registered Mobile Number, enter the Captcha, click "खोजें" (Search), verify the OTP sent to your phone, and download your digitally signed certificate as a PDF.
